reports.title: Veracyte Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Outlook
section: Veracyte now expects 2026 total revenue guidance of $590 million to $593 million, representing 14% to 15% growth, compared to prior guidance of $590 million to $596 million. This reflects testing revenue of $571 million to $573 million, representing 16% growth, compared to prior guidance of $576 million to $582 million, with minimal revenue contribution from recently launched tests. Further, the company continues to expect adjusted EBITDA margin of greater than 26% for 2026.
